lines: עֲזֹר לִי, אֲדֹנָי, לִחְיוֹת לְךָ לְמַעְלָה

review: The hymn is the journey with the Beginner and Finisher: 1:1–4 is Phil 1:6 with Ps 30:6, the chorus is Ps 23:1 with Ps 121:4, 2:1–4 is Mal 3:6 with Num 23:19, 3:1–4 is Jer 29:11 with Prov 16:9, and 4:1–4 is John 21:15 with Ps 86:11.
The chorus is only two lines (the print's [القرار] of two), and the payload keeps it short between stanza 1 and the rest, since the hymn's shape is testimony interrupted by a single act of thanks.

2:2–4 keep the threefold contrast between the changing speaker and the unchanging God, with the same verb שָׁנָה used of both and negated only of God; the print's بَاتْغَيَّرْ / مَا بتِتْغَيَّرْشِي is the same pun and the Hebrew must not lose it.
